title: Contract Pricing Agreement Tier Schedule A: Entry Gates and Annual Spend Commitments
content:
## Schedule A — Tier entry gates and spend commitments

The Contract Pricing Agreement is held at one of six tiers, ranked from the Corbett Account Price Schedule (lowest) to the Corbett Strategic Supply Agreement (highest). This schedule sets, for every tier, the entry gate a customer's purchase history must meet, the annual spend commitment written on the agreement, and the shortfall threshold applied at each agreement anniversary.

Columns, lowest tier to highest: **Account Price Schedule** = Corbett Account Price Schedule; **Volume Discount** = Corbett Volume Discount Agreement; **Category Contract** = Corbett Category Contract; **Net-Price** = Corbett Net-Price Contract; **Cost-Plus** = Corbett Cost-Plus Contract; **Strategic Supply** = Corbett Strategic Supply Agreement.

### A.1 Entry gates

| Entry term | Account Price Schedule | Volume Discount | Category Contract | Net-Price | Cost-Plus | Strategic Supply |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Trailing 12 month purchases with Corbett, at least (USD) | 0 | 20000 | 60000 | 200000 | 800000 | 2500000 |
| Active Commercial Credit Account required | No | Yes | Yes | Yes | Yes | Yes |
| Signed agreement required | No | Yes | Yes | Yes | Yes | Yes |

### A.2 Commitment and anniversary review terms

| Term | Account Price Schedule | Volume Discount | Category Contract | Net-Price | Cost-Plus | Strategic Supply |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Annual spend commitment (USD); 0 means no commitment | 0.00 | 25000.00 | 75000.00 | 250000.00 | 1000000.00 | 3000000.00 |
| Shortfall review threshold (percent of the commitment); 0 means no review | 0 | 70 | 75 | 80 | 80 | 85 |
| Window over which commitment spend is measured at an anniversary | trailing 12 months net shipped | trailing 12 months net shipped | trailing 12 months net shipped | trailing 12 months net shipped | trailing 12 months net shipped | trailing 12 months net shipped |

### Notes on the schedule

- The annual spend commitment is the annual net merchandise spend the customer commits to under the agreement, in USD. On the Corbett Account Price Schedule the figure is 0, meaning no commitment.
- The shortfall review threshold is the percent of the commitment below which trailing 12 month qualifying spend, measured at an agreement anniversary, moves the agreement down one tier. A threshold of 0 means the tier is never reviewed for shortfall.
- Hypothetical reading: on a tier with a commitment of 100000.00 and a threshold of 80 percent, the comparison figure is 80 percent of 100000.00, which is 80000.00. (Illustrative figures only; they are not the figures of any tier above.)
